name: Longhua Technology Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Longhua Technology Group Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells heat transfer and energy-saving equipment in China. The company is involved in research, development, production, and sale of new electronic materials and polymer composite materials; and environmental water treatment.
